summary: The sidebar uses host tokens paired to the surface they sit on: sidebar text and borders, list selection for rows, button colors only on primary and secondary actions. Target and mode choices are list rows, not filled buttons. Range icons inherit the row color. The rest of the walk is the design-system contract: tones, mode copy, and refresh that keeps input and focus.

.tabthrough-guide.json.rationale: The sidecar this walk is written into

test/unit/sidebar.test.ts.rationale: Assertions follow the new copy and list surfaces

test/unit/sidebar-html.test.ts.rationale: Markup checks for labels, paired tokens, and notes continuation

steps.title: Rows declare tone and surface
steps.rationale: The vocabulary the renderer uses instead of inferring primary from command names
steps.notes: tone is the immediate-task signal. surface is notice or disclosure. group repository parks git chrome after the explanation.

steps.title: Finish and exit name the mode
steps.rationale: Read-only and rebase must not share Finish review / Cancel review

steps.title: Thought first, count only in nav
steps.rationale: The session line is mode and target; edited on disk is a path notice, not a title suffix
steps.notes: Guide summary moves later as a disclosure. Completion copy is All N steps revealed, not a pass mark.

steps.title: Owned rebase stays out of the banner
steps.rationale: Continue rebase is primary only when the rebase is not the walk itself, or a conflict blocks it

steps.title: Target and mode are list rows
steps.rationale: Choices consume list tokens; they must not render as stacked secondary buttons

steps.title: Start explains the workspace
steps.rationale: Will run: nothing is gone — read-only working changes still save and snapshot

steps.title: Range bounds are icons only
steps.rationale: Start and End stay in aria-label; only commit rows reserve the icon column

steps.title: Primary comes from tone
steps.rationale: First consumer of the item contract — Next and Continue no longer share a name heuristic

steps.title: Each surface keeps its own tokens
steps.rationale: Bare buttons are no longer primary — that leak made GitHub and other themes paint every row accent
steps.notes: Canvas text is sideBar.foreground falling back to foreground. Borders are sideBar.border falling back to panel.border. button.* applies only to .primary and .secondary. Consequential is a neutral outline, not editorWarning.

steps.title: Hints inherit the control color
steps.rationale: descriptionForeground is a canvas token — on a secondary fill it vanishes
steps.notes: List rows on the canvas still use descriptionForeground. Selected list rows inherit the selection foreground, same pairing rule.

steps.title: List rows stay in the list family
steps.rationale: Selection, hover, and the between rail must not borrow editor, badge, or focusBorder colors
steps.notes: Icons use currentColor. Start and end use inactiveSelection. Between is a list-selection rail on a transparent row so hover still shows.

steps.title: Refresh keeps input and focus
steps.rationale: The update script restores value, caret, disclosures, and Next-to-Finish focus
steps.notes: A queued repeat on Next must not activate Amend and continue when the label swaps.

steps.title: Repository details after the walk
steps.rationale: Informational git state is grouped so it cannot push the thought below the fold

steps.title: Status bar does not grade the code
steps.rationale: All N steps revealed replaces Walkthrough complete · Finish

steps.title: Dim mode keeps diff colors
steps.rationale: Pending lines use a theme background instead of 0.4 opacity

steps.title: Tab past the last step is a no-op
steps.rationale: Advancing no longer opens a Review complete toast that offers Finish
